text: 到了小时候父母的样子，父母成了爷爷奶奶的样子。
en: We have grown to resemble our parents as they were when we were little, and our parents have grown to resemble our grandparents.

text: 到了父母各种疾病并发，长辈离世的年龄。
en: We have reached the age when our parents suffer various concurrent illnesses and our elders pass away.

text: 马上四十了
en: Almost forty now.

text: 什么都处于不可控的状态
en: Everything is in an uncontrollable state.

text: 体重，身体
en: Weight, body.

text: 工作随时被裁员
en: Could be made redundant at work at any moment.

text: 父母随时需要照顾
en: Parents may need care at any moment.

text: 小孩随叫随到
en: Children are on call at any moment.

text: 唯独没有自己的时间
en: Yet there is never any time for oneself.

text: 叫个啤酒都得偷偷摸摸的。
en: Even ordering a beer has to be done on the sly.

text: 等我四十岁，我还有二十三年才退休
en: When I turn forty, I will still have twenty-three years before I can retire.

text: 有的人活着，他已经死了。
en: Some people are alive, yet already dead.

text: 作者：若萍（富书作者）
en: Author: Ruoping (Fushu author)

text: “什么是生活的张力？
en: “What is the tension of life?

text: 知乎上有个高赞的回答是这样的：“能享受最好的，也能忍耐最坏的。
en: On Zhihu there is a highly upvoted answer like this: “Able to enjoy the best, and also able to endure the worst.

text: 确实，没有人能够拥有一直处于高峰的人生，我们免不了起起伏伏，从高点跌到低点，再从低点攀到高点，在波峰和波谷间轮流切换。
en: Indeed, no one can have a life that stays perpetually at its peak; we inevitably rise and fall, dropping from the highs to the lows, then climbing from the lows back to the highs, alternating in turns between the peaks and the troughs.

text: 如果没有承受落差的张力，那么生活将苦不堪言，大部分时间都会在焦虑和不安之间徘徊。
en: If we lack the tension to bear life's disparities, then life becomes unbearable, and for most of the time we will linger between anxiety and unease.

text: 所以，中年以后，活得高级的人，都具有“张力”。
en: Therefore, after middle age, those who live with refinement all possess “tension”.

text: 诚如木木所说：“有生活张力的人，往往更能乐观看待问题，积极应对挫折。
en: As Mumu said: “Those who possess the tension of life tend to view problems more optimistically and respond to setbacks positively.

text: 能承受最好的
en: Able to bear the best.

text: 海伦·凯勒写道：“快乐是一种选择，享受也是。
en: Helen Keller wrote: “Happiness is a choice, and so is enjoyment.

text: 有的人得到了梦寐以求的东西，总觉得有点不真实，忐忑不安，惶惶不可终日，就怕一不留神转瞬即逝，根本静不下心来好好享受；
en: Some people, having obtained what they once dreamed of, always feel it is somehow unreal, uneasy and agitated, terrified all day long, fearing it will vanish in an instant if they are not careful, and quite unable to calm down and truly enjoy it;

text: 有的人则是耀武扬威，骄傲得忘了形，摆出一副天下舍我其谁的架势，吆五喝六，不可一世，在吵嚷声里耗尽德行，落得个黯然下场；
en: Others swagger with arrogance, so proud they lose all restraint, putting on an air that the world belongs to no one but them, bellowing orders and acting utterly superior, exhausting their virtue amid the clamour and ending up in a dismal downfall;

text: 有的人却能淡然处之，平静地享受着拥有的一切，依旧保持人间清醒，温和谦逊，过好每一个细水长流的日子，有种优雅从容的洒脱。
en: Yet others can take it all in calm detachment, peacefully enjoying everything they have, still keeping a clear head amid the world, gentle and humble, living well each steady, unhurried day, with an elegant and composed ease.

text: 这份淡然，是无法伪装的，是一种阅历和沉淀，是一种见过世面的大格局。
en: Such composure cannot be feigned; it is a kind of experience and accumulation, a broad vision gained from having seen the world.

text: 想起了在《狂飙》电视剧爆红后的张颂文。
en: It puts me in mind of Songwen Zhang after the TV drama “The Knockout” became a huge hit.

text: 他去参加一个颁奖典礼，得到了众人高度的重视。
en: He went to attend an awards ceremony and was held in high regard by all.

text: 陈凯歌导演特地为他腾出了身边的位置；张艺谋导演十分赞赏他，主动邀请他合作。
en: Director Kaige Chen specially made room for him at his side; Director Yimou Zhang greatly admired him and took the initiative to invite him to collaborate.

text: 除此以外，各大品牌方都希望跟他互动，许多综艺节目和影视作品也纷纷向他抛出了橄榄枝。
en: Beyond that, major brands all wished to engage with him, and many variety shows and film and television productions also extended olive branches to him one after another.

text: 但张颂文依旧不骄不躁，一如既往。
en: But Songwen Zhang remained unassuming and unruffled, just as before.

text: 他选择“隐身”，主动减少自己的曝光度。
en: He chose to “lie low”, actively reducing his own exposure.

text: 他像平常一样，还是粉丝们的“贴心大哥”，无论多忙，都会抽时间予以回复。
en: As always, he remained the fans' “caring big brother”, and no matter how busy, would find time to reply to them.

text: 现实中遇到粉丝，会尽量地满足粉丝们的合影要求，不鼓励粉丝来看他，也不接受他们的礼物。
en: When he met fans in person, he would do his best to satisfy their requests for photos together, would not encourage fans to come and see him, and would not accept their gifts.

text: 他挑剧本还是很挑剔，不会只为了钱和热度而拍戏。
en: He remains very particular about choosing scripts, and will not act merely for money and popularity.

text: 《小窗幽记》里有这样的一句话：“澹泊之守，须从秾艳场中试来；镇定之操，还向纷纭境上勘过。
en: In “Notes from a Small Window” there is this saying: “The restraint of indifference must be tested amid scenes of lavish splendour; the steadiness of composure must be examined in the midst of turmoil.

text: 意思是说是否淡泊于心，通过富贵奢华一试便知，是否笃定如铁，通过纷扰嘈杂一观即可。
en: What it means is this: whether one is indifferent at heart can be known by a test of wealth and luxury, and whether one is as resolute as iron can be seen at a glance amid turmoil and noise.

text: 能承受最好的人，他们往往不受物质和名利的束缚，早已超脱物外，是个开悟之人，有今朝有酒今朝欢，明日无酒自在闲的洒脱，更能在生活中深耕厚植，笃行致远。
en: Those who can bear the best are often unbound by material things and fame, having long transcended the mundane world; they are enlightened souls, possessing the carefree ease of “wine today, rejoice today; no wine tomorrow, be free and idle”, and all the more can cultivate deeply in life and advance far through steadfast action.

text: 能忍受最差的
en: Able to endure the worst.

text: 伏契克曾说：“应该笑着面对生活，不管一切如何。
en: Julius Fučík once said: “One should face life with a smile, no matter what.

text: 世界上没有绝望的处境，只有对处境绝望的人。
en: There are no desperate situations in this world, only people who despair of their situation.

text: 面对逆境，如果逃避现实，往往没有翻身之地；如果乐观以待，常常能够收获转机。
en: When facing adversity, if we shy away from reality, we often find no chance to turn things around; if we meet it with optimism, we can often gain a turning point.

text: 汽车巨子亨利·福特在年轻时是个工程师。
en: The automotive magnate Henry Ford was an engineer in his youth.

text: 有次，他带队修筑一条河堤，不料突然来了暴风雨，大水淹没了所有的机器设备，辛苦构筑的工程也全遭摧毁。
en: Once, he led a team to build a river embankment, but unexpectedly a storm suddenly broke, and the flood submerged all the machinery and equipment; the project they had laboured to build was entirely destroyed.

text: 当洪水退去，队友们望着遍地的泥泞与东倒西歪的机器，面露愁容。
en: When the flood receded, the team members looked at the mud everywhere and the machines lying askew, their faces clouded with worry.

text: “你们怎么都哭丧着脸？
en: “Why are all of you pulling such long faces?

text: ”福特笑着问大家。
en: ”Ford asked everyone with a smile.

text: “你自己瞧！
en: “Look for yourself!

text: ”他们指着周围的东西说道。
en: ”They said, pointing at the things around them.

text: “我怎么没瞧见？
en: “How is it that I don't see anything?

text: ”福特爽朗地说，“但我也看到了蔚蓝的晴空和炙热的太阳。
en: ”Ford said cheerfully, “But I also see the azure sky and the blazing sun.

text: 太阳一晒，不久泥土就会结块，我们又能够重新开动推土机了，多好！
en: Once the sun shines on it, the mud will soon harden into clumps, and we will be able to start the bulldozers up again — how wonderful!

text: 海明威也是个心态积极之人。
en: Hemingway was also a person of positive mindset.

text: 晚年时，他病得很重，皮肤病、肝炎、肾炎、抑郁症等等不一而足。
en: In his later years he was gravely ill, with skin diseases, hepatitis, nephritis, depression and so on — more than could be listed.

text: 许多人纷纷议论，海明威不可能再写小说了。
en: Many people whispered among themselves that Hemingway could no longer write novels.

text: 然而，海明威并没有抱怨降临的苦难，也没有理会外界的冷眼，只是继续读书养性，靠写作来纾解心结。
en: Yet Hemingway did not complain about the suffering that had befallen him, nor did he heed the cold stares from the outside world; he simply kept reading to nurture his character, and relied on writing to untangle his inner knots.

text: 终于，在1952年，海明威写的《老人与海》一经问世，随即登上了文学巅峰。
en: Finally, in 1952, “The Old Man and the Sea”, written by Hemingway, was published and immediately reached the pinnacle of literature.

text: 我们每个人，总会经历挫折和坎坷，在困顿之际，不颓废、不崩溃，不被最后的一根稻草所裹挟，就已经赢了一半。
en: Each of us will inevitably face setbacks and hardships; when in difficulty, to neither degenerate nor collapse, nor be swept away by the last straw, is already to have won half the battle.

text: 在奔波途中，通过拓展自己的心胸、提升自己的本事来突破现实的瓶颈，永远是有效的上上签。
en: On the journey of rushing about, breaking through the bottleneck of reality by broadening one's mind and improving one's abilities is always the very best of omens.

text: 有张力的人生，进退自如
en: A life with tension advances and retreats with perfect ease.

text: 法国自然主义小说家左拉，年轻时很穷。
en: The French naturalist novelist Émile Zola was very poor when young.

text: 饥饿的他带着捕雀器爬到屋顶捉麻雀，用家里能找得到的铁丝串麻雀烤着吃。
en: Hungry, he climbed onto the roof with a sparrow trap to catch sparrows, then skewered the sparrows he could find around the house with wire and roasted them to eat.

text: 为了坚持写作，没钱的他只能把仅有的衣服拿去典当，碰上天寒地冻，被子是唯一的御寒之物。
en: To keep writing, with no money he could only pawn his few remaining clothes; when the weather turned freezing, the quilt was his only defence against the cold.

text: 如果偶然捡到蜡烛头，左拉会高兴得手舞足蹈，因为晚上他可以继续用功了。
en: If he chanced upon a candle stub, Zola would dance for joy, because at night he could continue his studies.

text: 这种困顿的境遇，他安之若素多年。
en: He took such destitution calmly for many years.

text: 后来，左拉写的《卢贡·马加尔家族》轰动一时，他成名了。
en: Later, “The Rougon-Macquart”, written by Zola, caused a sensation, and he became famous.

text: 丰厚的版税让左拉不再捉襟见肘。
en: The generous royalties meant Zola was no longer strapped for cash.

text: 左拉在巴黎西郊三十公里处的梅塘买了一幢心仪的别墅，这别墅非常符合他的审美，位于塞纳河边，环境优美，十分宁静。
en: Zola bought a villa to his liking thirty kilometres west of Paris, in Médan; it suited his taste perfectly, stood by the Seine, and offered beautiful, tranquil surroundings.

text: 装修房子时，左拉还特意种上自己小说里的奇花异草。
en: When fitting out the house, Zola also deliberately planted the exotic flowers and rare plants from his novels.

text: 小说中的大花园巴拉都园，在现实中被左拉付诸梅塘花园里，左拉真正实现了小说幻境变成现实的梦想。
en: The great garden, the Paradou, from his novel was brought to life by Zola in the Médan garden; Zola truly realised his dream of turning the novel's fantasy into reality.

text: 左拉在别墅里一边享受一边写作，日子过得轻松惬意。
en: In the villa, Zola both enjoyed himself and wrote, passing his days at ease and in contentment.

text: 不仅如此，左拉还邀请作家好友们来别墅吃喝玩乐，逐步形成了著名的文学沙龙，当时参加沙龙的有福楼拜、莫泊桑、龚古尔兄弟等，这些单身汉大作家吃饱喝足后，谈天说地、文思泉涌，让人羡慕。
en: What is more, Zola also invited his writer friends to the villa to eat, drink and make merry, gradually giving rise to a famous literary salon. Among those who took part at the time were Flaubert, Maupassant, the Goncourt brothers and others; after these bachelor men of letters had eaten and drunk their fill, they would talk of everything under the sun, their literary inspiration flowing like a spring — a sight to be envied.

text: 记得陈忠实在《漫漫人生，步履不停》中讲过：“能享福也能受罪，能人前也能人后，能站得起也能圪蹴得下，才活得坦然。
en: I recall Chen Zhongshi once said in “The Long Journey of Life, Never Stopping”: “To enjoy fortune yet also endure hardship, to stand before others yet also behind them, to be able to stand tall yet also to squat low — only then does one live with equanimity.

text: 低潮时享受琐碎，高潮时享受成就，坦然接受生活的给予，品味苦甜不同的滋味。
en: In the low tide, enjoy the trivial things; in the high tide, enjoy the achievements; accept what life gives with equanimity, and savour the differing flavours of bitterness and sweetness.

text: 忧虑之人，雨点落下都会天塌；达观之人，井口之间也是天地。
en: An anxious person sees the sky fall at the first raindrop; a broad-minded person finds heaven and earth within the mouth of a well.

text: 人生不过短短三万天，何不消解烦恼乐无边。
en: Life is but a mere thirty thousand days; why not dissolve our worries and find boundless joy.

text: 看过一则故事：
en: I once read a story:

text: 上帝让三个凡人回答他们来到这个世界是为了什么。
en: God asked three mortals to answer why they had come into this world.

text: 第一个人说：“我来到这个世界上是为了享受生活。
en: The first person said: “I came into this world to enjoy life.”

text: 第二个人说：“我来到这个世界上是为了承受痛苦。
en: The second person said: “I came into this world to bear suffering.”

text: 第三个人说：“我既要承担生活给我的磨难，又要享受生活赐予我的幸福。
en: The third person said: “I must both bear the hardships life gives me and enjoy the happiness life bestows on me.”

text: 上帝给前两个人打了50分，给第三个人打了100分。
en: God gave the first two people 50 points, and gave the third person 100 points.

text: 只有能承受最好的，又能忍受最差的，人生才能进退自如，松弛有度，中年以后，有张力的人生，才能更圆满、更持久。
en: Only those who can bear the best and also endure the worst can move through life with ease and poise, relaxed yet measured; only after middle age can a life of tension be more fulfilled and more enduring.

text: 那么，要如何来提高张力呢？
en: So, how might one cultivate this tension?

text: 大家不妨试试以下的方法。
en: You might as well try the following methods.

text: 1、接受现实
en: 1. Accept reality

text: 黑格尔有句名言：“凡是现实的都是合理的。
en: Hegel had a famous saying: “Whatever is real is rational.

text: 个人的境遇或多或少总会被社会洪流所左右，有时候我们拼尽全力，可能毫无起色；有时候我们略尽绵薄，可能满载而归。
en: An individual's circumstances are, more or less, always swayed by the social current; sometimes we exert our every effort yet see no improvement, while sometimes we contribute but a little yet return with a full load.

text: 我们不能对此耿耿于怀，或偏执地寻求一分耕耘一分收获，否则，撞到南墙也无济于事。
en: We must not brood over this, nor obsessively seek a strict one-to-one return for our efforts; otherwise, even running into a wall would be of no avail.

text: 毕竟，这世间本就没有绝对的因果，我们要学会坦然地接受现实。
en: After all, there is inherently no absolute cause and effect in this world; we must learn to accept reality with equanimity.

text: 接受现实是成长的必经之路，只有面对，才能超越。
en: Accepting reality is the inevitable path of growth; only by facing it can we transcend it.

text: 换个角度看世界，会收获不同的东西。
en: Looking at the world from a different angle, we gain different things.

text: 2、打开格局
en: 2. Broaden your vision

text: 每个人的一生都是在跟自己过。
en: Each person's entire life is spent contending with themselves.

text: 你纠结，你的人生也乌云密布；你欢乐，你的人生也嘻哈畅快。
en: When you are tangled in knots, your life is overcast with dark clouds; when you are joyful, your life is cheerful and carefree.

text: 但凡大气者，绝不会被一时的不顺牵绊，浑浑噩噩中消耗自己；也绝不会止步于眼前的荣宠，灯红酒绿里迷失自己。
en: Anyone with true breadth of spirit will never be held back by a momentary setback, wasting themselves in a muddle; nor will they ever come to rest at the favour before their eyes, losing themselves amid wine and revelry.

text: 他们的着力点，定格在未来的梦想中，并为之奋斗不息，终极往往必有所成。
en: Their focus is fixed upon the dreams of the future, and they strive tirelessly for them; in the end they are often sure to achieve something.

text: 大气成大器，大气方成大格局。
en: A broad spirit makes a great person; only a broad spirit can build a great vision.

text: 麻雀永远飞不到青云之上，因为它只盯着地面的稻谷；雄鹰之所以能在峰顶翱翔，因为它的眼里装满了山河。
en: A sparrow can never fly above the clouds, because it only fixes its eyes on the grain upon the ground; the reason an eagle can soar at the mountain peak is that its eyes are filled with rivers and mountains.

text: 曾国藩说：“谋大事者首重格局。
en: Guofan Zeng said: “Those who plan great undertakings prize a broad vision above all.

text: 格局大了，就能看淡暂时的得失，也就练就了生活的张力。
en: With a broader vision, one can take temporary gains and losses lightly, and thereby cultivate the tension of life.

text: 我们的生命只有一次，但我们如能正确地运用它，一次足矣。
en: We have only one life, but if we can use it rightly, once is enough.

text: 愿我们能在数十春秋里，怀揣着“张力”，即使是无人扶我青云志，也能我自踏雪王山巅。
en: May we, within these few decades, carry “tension” in our hearts; even if no one lends a hand to my soaring ambitions, I can still tread the snow to the summit of the king's mountain on my own.
